goal: Simplify workflow without regenerating content; preserve independent quality gates and full pinned Primer knowledge coverage

in_scope: Replace mandatory 14-step lesson graph with six steps: research, reusable plan gate, author, two combined independent reviews, validation. Add compact course and workflow templates.
Keep independent plan and actual-teaching coverage, technical correctness, pedagogy, provenance, draft status, negative-verdict blocking, task holds and two-revision limit.

Add strict full-Primer inventory/coverage validation, distinguishing knowledge topics from resources and planned mappings from actual teaching evidence. Reuse only exact accepted shared course artifacts; fail on missing/deferred knowledge coverage.
Align shared skills and entry-point docs; mark old pilot outputs/plans historical without rerunning or deleting valuable pinned evidence and review history.
out_of_scope: No curriculum, lesson, assessment, diagram or backlog generation; no resumption of held SD-CURRICULUM-REBOOT-PLAN.
No changes to existing taskctl lifecycle/gate engine or unrelated working-tree changes. No merge, publication or new model configuration.

constraints: User instruction 2026-11-10: simplify moderately, retain output quality and full knowledge coverage of System Design Primer, do not spend time regenerating outputs.
One writer @czyboi, Issue #8; retain the current pinned Primer revision ae9bbd7b02d90b9866215de185217d33f39ab733 for later course work.
The historical course coverage pass is not an accepted course: pedagogy recheck remains revise. Preserve this decision and all historical artifacts.
Preserve pre-existing modified hardening state/worklogs; commit only this task outputs.

definition_of_done.text: Executable templates and shared instructions agree on six default lesson steps, three course steps and two tooling steps; no automatic revision/copy/recheck loop. Full coverage validator and regressions reject omissions and false taught claims.
Independent bounded workflow/code review, required repository checks, exact validation results and feedback/cleanup disposition recorded. No learner outputs regenerated.

acceptance_criteria.text: Author requires an accepted plan review binding plan+inventory+matrix; validation requires both combined reviews of the exact pair, evidence and coverage inputs. Each combined review explicitly covers all assigned dimensions.

Machine checks require unique inventory topic IDs, a pinned SHA, complete source-to-lesson mapping with no silent omission/defer, and actual lesson paths/sections/hashes in taught mode. Independent review still verifies inventory completeness and teaching depth.
No lesson, assessment, curriculum or historical run artifact is created, regenerated, deleted or resumed. Superseded entry points route to the new workflow and explain pending course acceptance.

Run pip install -r requirements-dev.txt, python scripts/validate_content.py, python -m unittest discover -s tests -v, python scripts/taskctl.py validate and git diff --check; record outcomes truthfully.
